title: Analysis of Gait Patterns in Healthy Controls and Patients with Neurological Disorders
summary:
The aim of the study is to investigate gait in the general population. The data obtained will serve as comparative values for other DZNE studies.

Since neurodegenerative diseases often, but not only, occur in old age, this study will analyze exactly how the gait pattern changes over the course of a person's life.

This examination makes it possible to describe exactly what constitutes a healthy gait and how it changes with age. This knowledge helps to better recognize diseases and to better understand their effects on walking.
conditions: Helathy controls and patients with neurloglical disorder

interventions.name: TThe aim is to record and map the walking patterns of the general population. This will be done across the 18–85 age range. This range can be divided into 6 groups, each covering a 10-year age bracket (20–29, 30–39, etc.). The goal is to recruit 100 participants in each of these groups. In addition,
In addition, 100 patients with neurological disorders will be included

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Included are consenting adults of the general population
general population with an ability of 2-10 meters and no gait impairment
gait impairment (neurodegenerative disease such as ataxia, dementia
ataxia, dementia, motor and cerebellar disorders, and
sensory or motor neuropathies) are known and no gait aids are
gait aids are required (e.g. walking aids such as crutches or a rollator).
Exclusion criteria:
Persons incapable of giving consent and persons with impaired gait or who are dependent on gait aids are excluded from the study. In addition, adult patients with neurological disorders who are capable of giving informed consent and are enrolled in ongoing studies at the participating study centers will be included.
